text: When should I reach the Boarding Point? Passenger should report to the boarding point 15 mins prior of the Boarding time.
Does booking online cost me more? No, the fare will remain the same, however you could be benefited by discount offers.
What payment options are available? Tickets can be booked through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, and eWallets.

If the amount is deducted and the ticket is not confirmed, the amount will be reverted back to the same account from which the payment was made within 2-7 business working days. If it is not credited within that timeline, the customer should contact Fresh Bus support.
How will I get a refund if I cancel the ticket? Post cancellation, the refund amount will be reverted back to the same account from which the payment was made in 2-7 working days.
Do I get the refund if I missed the bus? No, the refund will not be processed if the passenger misses the bus.
Can I do partial cancellation on my ticket? Yes, you can cancel the seats that you want to.

Fresh Bus cancellation policy: below 6 hours before boarding, refund in Green Coins is 20% and cancellation refund percentage is 0%; 6-12 hours gives 70% Green Coins and 50% cancellation refund; 12-24 hours gives 85% Green Coins and 80% cancellation refund; above 24 hours gives 95% Green Coins and 85% cancellation refund.
Partial cancellation is allowed. Refunds for partial cancellations will be processed after the date of journey.
Bookings made via the Fresh Bus website or app can be cancelled only through the same platform. Refunds, if applicable, will be credited within 2-7 working days.
Passengers who are not present at the boarding point will not be eligible for refunds.
Once a ticket is booked, changes or modifications cannot be made.

Promo Green Coins are credited from marketing promotions, travel and earn campaigns, referrals, and signup offers. They can be used only for bookings and standard Promo Green Coins expire in 6 months. Non-Promo Green Coins are credited mainly from refunds and can be used for bookings or other product purchases and generally do not expire unless explicitly set for a specific transaction type.
Green Coin refunds are credited back in the same type they were originally used: NGC refunds as NGC and PGC refunds as PGC. Refund priority is NGC, then PGC, then Cash. Expired PGC is not refunded.
Green Coins cannot be withdrawn to a bank account.
Fresh Card gives 10% off the seat fare, up to ₹200 off per booking, on the next 10 trips. It is valid for 6 months and works on any route.
The Fresh Card is available at an introductory price of ₹99.
Fresh Card can only be used on the Fresh Bus website and Fresh Bus mobile app. It cannot be used for offline bookings.
Green Coins can be used along with the Fresh Card while booking, provided the customer has adequate balance.
Fresh Card cannot be transferred to someone else, but it can be used to book a ticket for someone else.
On full cancellation of a ticket, the used Fresh Card balance will be refunded. There are no refunds on partial cancellation.
Fresh Promise is Fresh Bus's on-time and reliability guarantee. The program applies when delay exceeds 90 minutes at the boarding or dropping point. It covers all Fresh Bus routes across India.

Fresh Bus sends the Fresh Promise payout link within about 12 hours of the scheduled drop time for a delay, or after a breakdown is confirmed. After authentication, the money reaches the customer's account in 5-7 working days.
If the bus breaks down and has not reached the destination city, the customer gets ₹1,000 and a full ticket refund. If it has already entered the destination city, the compensation is ₹500.
A requirement of 20 seats or more is treated as a group booking.
Fresh Bus can arrange a 44 reclining luxury seater bus and can provide up to 4 buses with a total capacity of 176 seats for large groups.
Fresh Bus provides group bookings for Corporate, Wedding, Social, Functions, Student and other needs.

For group bookings, 75% of the total amount is refunded if cancelled before 96 hours from boarding time, 50% if cancelled before 48 hours, and no amount is refunded if cancelled below 48 hours. If Fresh Bus cancels due to unavoidable circumstances, the full amount is refunded.
